description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance, measured as accuracy, across 11 datasets for different training methods. The horizontal axis displays the training method categories: “Standard”, “Self-RAG”, “FactTune”, “ClnGS (w/)", and “ClnGS”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals.  Five bars are presented, one for each training method. The “Standard” bar is colored orange and extends to approximately 52. The “Self-RAG” bar is gray and reaches a value of approximately 52. The “FactTune” bar is green and reaches approximately 50. The “ClnGS (w/)” bar is blue and rises to about 55. Lastly, the “ClnGS” bar is a darker blue and reaches a value of approximately 58. No bars appear to be visually emphasized, and the bar heights do not demonstrate a consistent ascending or descending order.
